test.create_query: CREATE TABLE pk_wide (CounterID UInt32, URL String, EventDate Date, Title String, UserID UInt64, EventTime DateTime, WatchID UInt64, RegionID UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 8 ORDER BY (CounterID, URL, EventDate, Title, UserID, EventTime, WatchID) SETTINGS index_granularity = 128
CREATE TABLE pk_urls (CounterID UInt32, URL String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (CounterID, URL)

CREATE TABLE parts_many (UserID UInt64, CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, EventTime DateTime, WatchID UInt64, RegionID UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 5000 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO pk_wide SELECT CounterID, URL, EventDate, Title, UserID, EventTime, WatchID, RegionID FROM hits_100m_single SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 16, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
OPTIMIZE TABLE pk_wide FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1, optimize_skip_merged_partitions = 1
INSERT INTO pk_urls SELECT CounterID, URL FROM pk_wide GROUP BY CounterID, URL ORDER BY cityHash64(CounterID, URL) LIMIT 100000

INSERT INTO parts_many SELECT UserID, CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, WatchID, RegionID FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash32(UserID) % 2 = 0 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_block_size = 1000000000, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
